sents.zh: 金朝有一个很爱读书的人。
sents.en: In the Jin dynasty there was a man who loved to read.

sents.zh: 他看的书很多，什么都看。
sents.en: He read a great many books, on everything.

sents.zh: 看到好的东西，他就写下来。
sents.en: When he saw something good, he wrote it down.

sents.zh: 一年一年，本子越来越多。
sents.en: Year after year, the notebooks grew.

sents.zh: 后来他老了，不能再写了。
sents.en: Later he grew old and could write no more.
But his notebooks were still there.

sents.zh: 很多年以后，别人还在看它们。
sents.en: Many years later, others were still reading them.

sents.zh: 他写下的东西，帮了很多人。
sents.en: What he wrote down helped many people.
